SELECT 
    DATE(pago.fecha) AS fecha,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pago.aprobado = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*), 4) AS tasa_aprobacion
FROM pagos
WHERE pago.medio = 'tarjeta'
    AND pago.aprobado IS NOT NULL
    AND DATE(pago.fecha) >= '2026-03-01'
    AND DATE(pago.fecha) <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY DATE(pago.fecha)
ORDER BY fecha;
